rv.q: Cate Blanchett is ready for her closeup, Mr. Genet -- and in all of the demented desperation that suggests. The thrill of watching this Oscar winner and stage animal go belly-up in all her game-for-anything glory comes thanks to the Sydney Theatre Company's wild and woolly but weirdly lopsided production of Jean Genet's 1947 play, "The Maids"...
